name: Srednoff OS design and growth source registry

sources.name: 21st.dev
sources.license: varies by component; verify at source before copying
sources.provenance: external component marketplace via Magic/21st.dev; inspect source page and dependency tree before adoption
sources.copy_policy: copy-adapt-upgrade only after license, provenance, accessibility, dependency, and visual QA checks

sources.name: shadcn/ui registry
sources.license: MIT for shadcn/ui source; verify third-party registry item license before copying
sources.provenance: official shadcn/ui registry documentation and registry item metadata
sources.copy_policy: prefer stack-native registry items; adapt locally and keep provenance note for copied code

sources.name: shadcn MCP server
sources.license: MIT for shadcn/ui source; verify third-party registry item license before copying or installing
sources.provenance: official shadcn MCP documentation; inspect registry namespace, item metadata, dependencies, and target paths
sources.copy_policy: use for browse/search before install; install or copy only after project fit, provenance, accessibility, and dependency checks

sources.name: Magic UI
sources.license: verify at source before copying
sources.provenance: external animated component documentation; inspect component source and package requirements
sources.copy_policy: adapt effects selectively; avoid copying if license or dependency cost is unclear

sources.name: Aceternity UI
sources.license: verify at source before copying
sources.provenance: external component documentation; inspect source, animation dependencies, and usage terms
sources.copy_policy: copy only with confirmed license; prefer pattern extraction for visual effects

sources.name: Origin UI
sources.license: verify at source before copying
sources.provenance: external component library; inspect component page and any linked repository before reuse
sources.copy_policy: prefer simple patterns; keep copied code minimal and project-native

sources.name: React Bits
sources.license: verify at source before copying
sources.provenance: external animated React component source; inspect animation/runtime dependencies
sources.copy_policy: copy only small effects with confirmed license and measured performance budget

sources.name: Astryx
sources.license: MIT
sources.provenance: official Meta Open Source repository, Astryx documentation, Storybook, package metadata, and v0.4.1 release notes
sources.copy_policy: install only after React 19, StyleX peer dependency, lockfile, bundle, and pre-1.0 upgrade review; prefer stable core/theme packages, exclude lab and canary charts, and validate focus, live regions, RTL, i18n, RSC boundaries, and visual regressions

sources.name: Figma
sources.license: user-provided file rights; do not copy third-party assets without user rights
sources.provenance: Figma connector or user-provided design file; preserve source file reference
sources.copy_policy: use as design specification; export/copy assets only when user rights are explicit

sources.name: Figma MCP server
sources.license: user-provided file rights; Figma plan, access, and asset rights must be verified
sources.provenance: official Figma MCP documentation; preserve file URL, node references, design-token source, and user authorization context
sources.copy_policy: use as design context and token/spec source; export or copy assets only when the user has rights and requests it

sources.name: Canva
sources.license: user-provided file rights; Canva asset terms may vary
sources.provenance: Canva connector or user-provided creative; preserve source design reference
sources.copy_policy: use for approved marketing assets; verify rights before export or reuse

sources.name: Canva Dev MCP server
sources.license: Canva developer docs and user-owned app assets; verify Canva terms and asset rights before reuse
sources.provenance: official Canva Dev MCP documentation for Canva apps and integrations; separate developer tooling from creative connector output
sources.copy_policy: use for Canva app/integration development assistance; do not publish, export, or modify user designs without explicit approval

sources.name: MCP Apps
sources.license: Apache-2.0 for SDK docs site badge; verify repository package/license metadata before copying examples
sources.provenance: Official MCP Apps extension docs and SEP-1865; use modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps as implementation source
sources.copy_policy: use for interactive UI returned by MCP tools; keep UI resources sandboxed, typed, auditable, accessible, and backed by text fallback

sources.name: Three.js
sources.license: MIT
sources.provenance: official Three.js project, API documentation, and WebGPURenderer migration guide
sources.copy_policy: use official APIs and examples as patterns; keep WebGPURenderer experimental, test its WebGL2 fallback, budget async initialization, and migrate legacy ShaderMaterial/onBeforeCompile/EffectComposer paths to TSL before adoption; verify example asset licenses separately

sources.name: React Three Fiber
sources.license: MIT
sources.provenance: official pmndrs React Three Fiber documentation
sources.copy_policy: use when project is React-based; prefer idiomatic hooks/components and profile runtime cost

sources.name: model-viewer
sources.license: Apache-2.0
sources.provenance: official model-viewer documentation and project
sources.copy_policy: prefer for simple glTF/AR display; validate model size, accessibility fallback, and browser support

sources.name: Babylon.js
sources.license: Apache-2.0
sources.provenance: official Babylon.js documentation and project
sources.copy_policy: use for complex 3D scenes; verify bundle impact and choose over Three.js only when feature fit is stronger

sources.name: glTF Transform
sources.license: MIT
sources.provenance: official glTF Transform documentation and CLI/API project
sources.copy_policy: use for optimization pipelines; record compression settings and validate output visually

sources.name: Khronos glTF Sample Assets
sources.license: varies by asset; verify asset license before copying
sources.provenance: KhronosGroup glTF sample assets repository; inspect per-asset license metadata
sources.copy_policy: use mainly for tests/fixtures; do not ship without per-asset license confirmation

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.license: CC0
sources.provenance: Poly Haven asset library; keep asset URL and downloaded asset metadata
sources.copy_policy: prefer CC0 HDRI/textures; still record asset URL, file size, and performance budget

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.license: CC0
sources.provenance: ambientCG material library; keep asset URL and chosen texture resolution
sources.copy_policy: prefer CC0 PBR materials; cap texture resolution to project performance budget

sources.name: Sketchfab
sources.license: varies by asset; verify per-download license before copying
sources.provenance: Sketchfab marketplace asset page; record author, asset URL, license, and download date
sources.copy_policy: do not copy automatically; require explicit user approval plus license, attribution, size, and security review

sources.name: Webflow MCP server
sources.license: MIT for the official server; Webflow account, site, and asset terms remain separate
sources.provenance: official Webflow MCP server and Data API repository
sources.copy_policy: use read-only discovery first; require a scoped confirmation before site, CMS, style, component, asset, or publish changes

sources.name: Miro MCP server
sources.license: Miro service terms and user-owned board content
sources.provenance: official Miro AI repository and MCP setup documentation
sources.copy_policy: read approved boards first; require explicit approval before creating or editing frames, diagrams, cards, tables, or documents

sources.name: Storybook MCP
sources.license: verify repository package license and connected Storybook access before installation
sources.provenance: Storybook organization MCP repository and its published configuration guidance
sources.copy_policy: use for component inventory and evidence; validate branch/build currency and do not treat generated examples as production code

sources.name: Playwright MCP
sources.license: Apache-2.0
sources.provenance: official Microsoft Playwright MCP repository and installation documentation
sources.copy_policy: prefer isolated contexts, allowed hosts, workspace-scoped outputs, and read-only QA; use CLI/tests where they are cheaper than persistent MCP state

sources.name: MCP Apps Three.js example
sources.license: Apache-2.0 for the official ext-apps repository; verify any copied assets separately
sources.provenance: official modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps Three.js server example
sources.copy_policy: adapt concepts only; use typed allowlisted scene inputs, restrictive CSP, accessibility fallback, and measured rendering budgets instead of executing arbitrary scene code

sources.name: UX MCP Server
sources.license: verify repository license, packaged corpus provenance, and network/tool permissions before installation
sources.provenance: third-party UX knowledge and analysis MCP server; external corpus is not treated as authoritative
sources.copy_policy: use only as a supplementary checklist after provenance review; defer to official standards and project evidence for accessibility, privacy, and compliance claims
